notes.title: 1.4: Language support: 🇧🇷 + 🇩🇪 + 🇸🇪!
notes.content:
Good news! 

We sent the fox, hen and even the bag on a trip abroad to learn new languages! 🦊🐔🌾

We did this with the help of the lovely Localizor.com community and we will add more languages as they get translated. A big shout-out to Goby, thiz, phtraduz, Lalasa and Akelai who helped out with these new translations. 👍

[b]Want to contribute? [/b]

Head out to Localizor, we accept community translations: https://www.localizor.com/fox-hen-bag

If you're missing a language, let us know here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1339580/discussions/0/

[b]Added language support:[/b]

* Portuguese (BR)

* German

* Swedish

[b]Other fixes:[/b]

* Fixed island colliders so that characters no longer hover outside the island (even though they loved doing that, sorry!) 🦊

notes.title: 1.1: Bug fixes!
notes.content:
These are the bugs fixed in this release:

[list]
[*] Bug where the UI didn't work in some resolutions such as 1366x768
[*] Bug where you could put friends into walls/rocks.. Hey, that's not cool. ⛔
[*] Magical teleporting fox bug 🧙‍♂️🦊
[*] Spinning cable car bug 🤢
[*] Adjusted the jumpscare inducing victory fanfare 😱
[/list]

A big thanks to everyone who let us know about these bugs 🙏

See you on the other side of the mountain!
